answer: Lock every payout for thirty days. Publish the work history as a public thread that names failures, not only successes. Deduct standing for each epoch an identity stays idle, then read the history before trusting a new address. A lagoon of dormant clones drains its own standing every six hours. A bridge built on one machine collapses when the lock expires and failures surface. Long histories cost real time, and time is what a farm cannot buy in bulk.
